map.→ 打开合同日期校验工具: -> Open the contract date validation tool
map.勾选“约定自动续期”后，到期状态显示为“已自动续期”，应提示核对续展次数上限与续: With "auto-renew by agreement" checked, the status at expiry shows as "auto-renewed"; the renewal count limit and renewal conditions should be checked to avoid disputes over indefinite renewal.
map.普通履行期校验：签订 2024-01-10、生效 2024-02-01、终止 2: Ordinary term validation: signed 2024-01-10, effective 2024-02-01, terminated 2025-01-31, a term of 365 days (about 1 year); if the contract is currently in performance it can show the remaining days and progress.
map.校验合同签订日、生效日、终止日的逻辑合理性，计算合同期限，并判断合同当前状态。: Validates the logic of the signing, effective and termination dates, computes the contract term and determines the current contract status.
map.生效日早于签订日有什么风险？: What is the risk of an effective date earlier than the signing date?
map.生效日晚于签订日：签订 2024-03-01、生效 2024-06-01，工具提: An effective date later than signing: signed 2024-03-01, effective 2024-06-01, and the tool reports "takes effect 92 days after signing", avoiding a validity dispute caused by a logical contradiction.
map.算例：一年期合同期限换算: Example: converting a one-year contract term
map.约定提前通知终止：终止日 2025-12-31、需提前 30 天通知，最后通知日: Agreed early termination: termination 2025-12-31 with 30 days notice required, so the last notice date is 2025-12-01 and missing it may void the unilateral termination.
map.自动续期条款如何呈现？: How is the auto-renewal clause presented?
map.除非约定附条件或附期限生效，否则生效日早于签订日存在逻辑矛盾，可能影响合同效力起: Unless a conditional or deferred effective date is agreed, an effective date earlier than the signing date is a logical contradiction that may affect when the contract becomes binding, so check the clause before signing.
map.：生效 2024-02-01、终止 2025-01-31，期限 = 2025-0: : effective 2024-02-01 and terminated 2025-01-31 gives a term of 2025-01-31 - 2024-02-01 = 365 days. If today is 2024-06-10, then 130 days have been performed with 235 remaining, progress about 35.6%; the status check finds today within [effective, termination] so the contract is in performance. For the notice period, 30 days before the 2025-12-31 termination makes 2025-12-01 the last notice date.
